title: Cloud Native Security Services | Quadra
description: Quadra, a global award-winning partner, architects the Intelligent Enterprise for the world's leading businesses. We transform complex Cloud & AI innovation into a competitive advantage, built on 25 years of deep, vendor-agnostic architectural expertise.

blocks.text: Security for the Speed of Cloud

As you build and deploy applications in the cloud, how do you ensure security is integrated across the entire lifecycle, from the first line of code to the production workload, without slowing down your developers?

blocks.alt: 3 women sitting on chair in front of table with laptop computers

blocks.text: We architect a unified Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) framework. Our blueprint integrates Fortinet's adaptive cloud security for posture management with CrowdStrike's industry-leading runtime protection. This provides a single, cohesive solution for security across your entire multi-cloud application lifecycle

Our capabilities provide unified protection across the entire application lifecycle, integrating security from your CI/CD pipeline to your production workloads to protect your cloud without slowing down innovation.
Real-time identification of misconfigurations and compliance risks.
